'''The Chase''' was the an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] orbiting the [[Binary star/Legends|binary stars]] [[Toydar/Legends|Toydar]] and [[Little Toydar/Legends|Little Toydar]] in the [[Toydaria system/Legends|Toydaria system]]. Located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], it was situated beyond the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fii]].
